data.envoy.yaml:
node: {id: agent-router-controller-tls, cluster: agent-router}
static_resources:
  listeners:
    - name: extension
      address:
        socket_address: {address: "::", ipv4_compat: true, port_value: 1163}
      filter_chains:
        - transport_socket:
            name: envoy.transport_sockets.tls
            typed_config:
              "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.DownstreamTlsContext
              common_tls_context:
                alpn_protocols: [h2]
                tls_params:
                  tls_minimum_protocol_version: TLSv1_2
                tls_certificate_sds_secret_configs:
                  - name: serving
                    sds_config:
                      resource_api_version: V3
                      path_config_source:
                        path: /etc/podplane-tls/serving.yaml
          filters:
            - name: envoy.filters.network.tcp_proxy
              typed_config:
                "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.tcp_proxy.v3.TcpProxy
                stat_prefix: extension
                cluster: extension
                idle_timeout: 0s
    - name: ratelimit-xds
      address:
        socket_address: {address: "::", ipv4_compat: true, port_value: 18003}
      filter_chains:
        - transport_socket:
            name: envoy.transport_sockets.tls
            typed_config:
              "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.transport_sockets.tls.v3.DownstreamTlsContext
              common_tls_context:
                alpn_protocols: [h2]
                tls_params:
                  tls_minimum_protocol_version: TLSv1_2
                tls_certificate_sds_secret_configs:
                  - name: serving
                    sds_config:
                      resource_api_version: V3
                      path_config_source:
                        path: /etc/podplane-tls/serving.yaml
          filters:
            - name: envoy.filters.network.tcp_proxy
              typed_config:
                "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.tcp_proxy.v3.TcpProxy
                stat_prefix: ratelimit-xds
                cluster: ratelimit-xds
                idle_timeout: 0s
  clusters:
    - name: extension
      type: STATIC
      connect_timeout: 5s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: extension
        endpoints:
          - lb_endpoints:
              - endpoint:
                  address:
                    socket_address: {address: 127.0.0.1, port_value: 1063}
    - name: ratelimit-xds
      type: STATIC
      connect_timeout: 5s
      load_assignment:
        cluster_name: ratelimit-xds
        endpoints:
          - lb_endpoints:
              - endpoint:
                  address:
                    socket_address: {address: 127.0.0.1, port_value: 18002}
